# laravelforge_recipe_runs (Resource)

Run a given recipe on a list of servers.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "laravelforge_recipe_runs" "example" {
  organization = "my-org"
  recipe       = 1
  servers      = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) The organization slug
- `recipe` (Number) The recipe ID
- `servers` (List of Number) The servers on which to run the recipe on.

### Optional

- `email` (Boolean) Whether to send an email notification when the recipe has completed.
- `log` (Number) The log ID

### Read-Only

- `executed_by` (Number)
- `finished_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `output` (String)
- `recipe_id` (Number)
- `server_id` (Number)
- `started_at` (String)
- `status` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import laravelforge_recipe_runs.example my-org/1/123
```
